title: Speech & Audio Processing
summary: This module provides a comprehensive suite of models for various speech and audio tasks, including speech-to-text, text-to-speech, speech-to-speech translation, and speaker recognition.

nodes.label: Speech-to-Text Models
nodes.title: Speech-to-Text Models
nodes.description: Models that transcribe spoken audio into text, utilizing various architectures like CTC and conditional generation.

nodes.label: Text-to-Speech Models
nodes.title: Text-to-Speech Models
nodes.description: Models that synthesize human-like speech from input text, supporting different languages and speaker IDs.

nodes.label: Speech-to-Speech Models
nodes.title: Speech-to-Speech Models
nodes.description: Models designed for direct speech-to-speech translation, converting spoken input in one language to spoken output in another.

nodes.label: Speaker Recognition Models
nodes.title: Speaker Recognition Models
nodes.description: Models that extract speaker-specific features (X-Vectors) from audio for tasks like speaker identification and verification.

nodes.label: Audio Pre-training & Classification
nodes.title: Audio Pre-training and Classification
nodes.description: Models for pre-training on large audio datasets and for various audio classification tasks, such as audio frame classification.

groups.label: Audio Input Processing
groups.title: Audio Input Processing
groups.description: Handles the initial processing and feature extraction from raw audio data for various downstream tasks.

groups.label: Text Output Generation
groups.title: Text Output Generation
groups.description: Modules responsible for generating textual output from speech or other input modalities.

groups.label: Audio Output Synthesis
groups.title: Audio Output Synthesis
groups.description: Modules dedicated to synthesizing speech or other audio outputs.

groups.label: Core Audio Analysis
groups.title: Core Audio Analysis
groups.description: Fundamental components for analyzing and transforming audio data, including pre-training and classification.
